fee_intelligence_NEW.HEADLINE: The 0.535% front-end fee equals 1.227 YEARS of the 0.436025% management fee. For a 3-month-to-2-year holder the entry charge, not the TER, is the dominant fee.
fee_intelligence_NEW.actionable: Holding period alone swings the annualised fee by 4x. This is a direct argument for the LONG end of Tho's 3mo-2yr mandate on this position, and against incremental top-ups - each new purchase pays the full 0.535% again.

fed_frame.why_it_moved: Two data points landed between the 6 Aug FedWatch reading and tonight: a large July jobs MISS on 7 Aug, and July CPI cooling on 12 Aug. Both cut the same way.
fed_frame.honest_caveat: This frame has now been restated in four consecutive runs, twice reversing direction. The 12 Aug run adopted a 55% hike probability that was already six days stale when it was used. The lesson is not that the current read is better - it is that a policy frame rebuilt nightly from whatever headline is freshest will oscillate. It should be revised on data releases, not on runs.
